gloss: to taper to a point; to become sharp; to become tense

definitions.gloss: to taper to a point; to become sharp
definitions.explanation: To narrow or sharpen to a pointed end.

definitions.gloss: to become tense; to be on edge
definitions.explanation: To become irritable or nervous, often shown in facial expression.

notes:
{尖|とが}る is intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive pair is {尖|とが}らせる (to sharpen, to make pointed).

ASPECT ({ている}):
{尖|とが}っている indicates a resulting state of being pointed or sharp.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {先|さき}が{尖|とが}る (the tip becomes sharp)
- {神経|しんけい}が{尖|とが}る (nerves become frayed)
- {口|くち}を{尖|とが}らせる (to pout - uses transitive form)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～が{尖|とが}る: What becomes pointed

The figurative sense of being "on edge" or tense is common in everyday conversation.
